scripts.aspire:require-cli: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync('aspire', ['--version'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); if (result.error || result.status !== 0) { console.error('Aspire CLI is required. Run aspire update --self --channel staging --yes --non-interactive.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.aspire:restore: npm run aspire:require-cli && aspire restore --apphost apphost.mts --non-interactive
scripts.aspire:start: npm run aspire:require-cli && aspire run --apphost apphost.mts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @adamratzman/contracts --if-present && npm run build --workspace @adamratzman/api --if-present && npm run build --workspace @adamratzman/web && npm run aspire:build:auto-restore
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @adamratzman/contracts --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace @adamratzman/contracts --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace @adamratzman/api --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace @adamratzman/web && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run aspire:build:auto-restore
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @adamratzman/contracts --if-present && npm run lint --workspace @adamratzman/api --if-present && npm run lint --workspace @adamratzman/web && eslint playwright.config.ts e2e && npm run aspire:lint:auto-restore
